notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese Translation Added!
notes.content:
- Update 1.10

A Brazilian Portuguese translation has been added to the game thanks to Filipe de Lima. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.content:
Fixed a few grammar and punctuation errors.

I also want to inform you that several new languages are coming soon. These are:

- French
- German
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Polish
- Italian
- Turkish

These languages are also likely to be added but are not yet a sure thing:

- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Czech
- Hungarian
- Romanian

notes.content:
Text fixes yet again. Corrected grammar, typos, and punctuation for the whole game.

notes.title: Release, Discount + Uncensored Patch
notes.content:
The game is finally released! I apologize for the many sudden delays. There are really no excuses except that I really truly thought I could finish the game on time, but it was a bigger task than I anticipated.

The game will have a discount of 10% during the first week of release which means you can get it for $0.89.

Furthermore, there is also a small uncensored patch you can download by heading to the forum.
